 composition rung measures the orthogonal question — stages handing their Rian output

-(4 stages), over the whole real compiler-stage files whose ENTIRE front-end is verified ports — tokenized by selfhost_lexer_v2, parsed by selfhost_decl (def heads, multi-clause patterns incl. cons-LISTS and TUPLES, SUM-TYPE/STRUCT declarations + constructor dispatch, `if`, `case` with guards, strings/chars, atoms, struct field access, `@external` FFI, `forall` generics, arithmetic + calls) — and compiled by the selfhost_beam backend; all THREE ports called CROSS-MODULE (incl. remote calls), with only a surface→Core lowering + Form inflater as driver glue.
